nodes.question: How many days has the Heat Wave (HW) season in Athens extended per decade since the 1960s?
nodes.answer: The Heat Wave (HW) season in Athens has extended by up to 7 days per decade since the 1960s.

Cities function as complex, dynamic systems with global impacts, where local actions can inadvertently shift prob - lems elsewhere or defer them to the future. To address global challenges like climate change and achieve the UN's New Urban Agenda and Sustainable Development Goals, a sys- items approach is essential. This involves understanding the interactions, trade-offs, and synergies between urban pro- cesses and their wider impacts (Bai et al. 2018). Expand- ing nexus approaches , which analyze connections among various environmental pressures to geographically identi- fied vulnerable areas, can offer deeper insights and more effective solutions. The distribution, but also the morphol - ogy of urban vegetation significantly influences the existing environmental pressures of the city. For instance, various studies have highlighted the importance of vegetation design in improving air quality, whereas others demonstrated that large trees in street canyons can worsen air pollution by reducing air mixing (Janh Il 2015).
